purpose: Reviewed photo action layout and read-only shared memo projection. The same visible photo remains bound to favorite, private memo, send and related-photo actions. Delivery captions and existing same-space/same-moment active words share the photo footer; sent captions retain their original author. Reading performs no record creation. Existing photo entries, including withdrawn photos, retain active words and explicit additions without photo re-upload. Only the current author may edit their words; existing permission, lifecycle, revision, persistence, delivery and identity contracts remain unchanged. Eight existing native operations and all mandatory safety jobs remain required; this is not a general UI exemption. The reviewed repair owns memo state and sheets above the adaptive footer in received, sent and fixture photo screens, preserving the editor during keyboard layout changes. Caption-only sources perform no record load. The shared-note test verifies keyboard focus before typing. The editor destination also captures its source at opening so a later caption-only state cannot replace an unsaved editor with an empty sheet; existing save validation remains authoritative. The DEBUG-only private-note fixture uses a validated per-test UUID file name, preserved across relaunch; invalid or absent session values retain the existing state.json default. This removes system text-menu cleanup while preserving initial isolation, save/relaunch, exact-photo, explicit-send and original-text assertions. Production editor/store code and the mandatory exact-photo deletion verifier remain unchanged.
